title: Relation between mass and energy: the split (ভর ও শক্তির সম্পর্ক: নিউক্লিয়াস ভাঙা)
placement: Book page 119, topic 4.6: ৪.৬ ভর ও শক্তির সম্পর্ক (Relation between mass and energy). Next to চিত্র ৪.০৬ (নিউক্লিয়ার বিক্রিয়ায় শক্তি উৎপাদন) and the equation ¹₀n + ²³⁵₉₂U → ⁹²₃₆Kr + ¹⁴¹₅₆Ba + 3¹₀n, with the paragraphs on E = mc² and the chain reaction.
description: Interactive 3D figure for textbook topic 4.6 (page 119), the book's চিত্র ৪.০৬ brought to life in two scenes in the same reactor pool. (1) একটি নিউক্লিয়াস: in the deep blue water of a reactor pool, a slow neutron flies into a glowing uranium-235 nucleus of 92 red protons (with +) and 143 grey neutrons; the nucleus takes it in, becomes unstable (অস্থিতিশীল), wobbles, stretches into a dumbbell and splits into ⁹²Kr and ¹⁴¹Ba (their own balls, 36 p + 56 n and 56 p + 85 n, flying apart with equal and opposite momentum) and three fast neutrons with streaks, with a flash and the book's yellow star of শক্তি. The panel shows the book's equation with each side's mass (236.0526 u and 235.8667 u, AME2020 atomic masses) and a small balance that tips to the heavier left side, and works E = mc² out with the missing 0.1859 u (3.09 × 10⁻²⁸ kg): 2.78 × 10⁻¹¹ J for one nucleus. (2) চেইন রি-অ্যাকশন: the three neutrons, slowed on their way, split three more nuclei, whose nine neutrons split nine more (1 → 3 → 9, 13 splits and their energy). Both play from the big action button and can be replayed and scrubbed with a slider or the arrow keys. Sizes and times are not to scale (said in the panel). Four test questions (the neutrons, the missing mass, the chain, why so much energy). The power plant is its own lab (mass-energy-plant). The nucleus exports as GLB (1 cm = 1 fm). Offline, Bangla and English.
